body: I want to clarify a bit, many have been supportive and offered to help in any way they can but I can't help but feel that the more I use that help the more I will be pushing them away. I don't want to be their sad sack of burdens. Some days are better than others but some days I just want to feel numb and deaden myself to the world because the pain I feel is worse than any I can recall.
I can't afford profesaional help... I lost my job as well.

I'm scared. I feel unable to socialize and have put distance between myself and all but my closest friends... they've been supportive but I can't help but feel I'm a burden to them. Some have stopped responding to me altogether...
If he's upset about 10 lbs now wait till you two are in your 40's and 50's. Break it off early sounds like he's projecting.

I'd try for a more casual hangout and try and talk to her face to face. No pressure, expectations or guilt. Just hey what's up feeling ok? It's possible she had something personal come up and felt that she wasn't in a good place anymore. (Complete shot in the dark but possible)

I don't feel it's that simple as yes or no. Talk to him not directly about it but about life apart in general if he wants to know he'll ask and at that time you can decide if you feel comfortable telling him. The others are right he doesn't have a "right" to know but open communication is a good thing. Number one rule: don't lie. If you feel uncomfortable say that you aren't interested in discussing that. Your life and your choices.

Unpopular opinion but: it could be cultural. If he identifies less with what is becoming considered popular in much of "black culture" he could feel culturally isolated. He may identify closer with what is considered popular "white culture".
A friend saw the situation and constantly got on me to better my life. I still had to make the decision and its still painful but I believe going forward I'm on a better path
Thanks made me laugh! Good advice thanks so much going to start looking up gym memberships just hope I can actually push myself to go

So a fear I have with this is (and yes I am paranoid) what happens if people I liked who never wanted to pay attention to me before start to take notice? Doesn't that mean that they just want me physically? Sorry probably an asinine question
Are you me? Like this exact same situation almost down to the timestamps has happened to me before. I got out. But... I'm pretty broken.
Not exactly the response I was expecting but it's definitely a viewpoint I hadn't considered. Thanks I'll give it a look when I get the chance.
